title: nvim 0.8.0 slow when opening large files with "filetype on" or "syntax on"

labels.name: bug-regression
labels.description: wrong behavior that was introduced in a previous commit (please bisect)

body:
### Neovim version (nvim -v)

v0.8.0-dev-872-gbccb5de89

### Vim (not Nvim) behaves the same?

no, vim 9.0.135

### Operating system/version

Ubuntu 22.04

### Terminal name/version

konsole 21.12.3

### $TERM environment variable

xterm-256color

### Installation

GitHub releases, PPA

### How to reproduce the issue

# Script

```bash
tmpdir=$(mktemp -d)
trap "rm -r $tmpdir" EXIT
largefile="$tmpdir/largefile"

nvim_072="$tmpdir/nvim-linux64_0.7.2"
curl -L "https://github.com/neovim/neovim/releases/download/v0.7.2/nvim-linux64.tar.gz" -o "${nvim_072}.tar.gz" 2> /dev/null
mkdir "$nvim_072"
tar -xzf "${nvim_072}.tar.gz" -C "$nvim_072"

nvim_080="$tmpdir/nvim-linux64_0.8.0"
curl -L "https://github.com/neovim/neovim/releases/download/nightly/nvim-linux64.tar.gz" -o "${nvim_080}.tar.gz" 2> /dev/null
mkdir "$nvim_080"
tar -xzf "${nvim_080}.tar.gz" -C "$nvim_080"

for i in {1..1000000}; do
    echo "ATGCATGCATGCATGCATGCATGCATGCATGCATGCATGCATGCATGCATGCATGCATGCATGCATGC" >> "$largefile"
done
du -sh $largefile

for vim in /usr/bin/vim "$nvim_072/nvim-linux64/bin/nvim" "$nvim_080/nvim-linux64/bin/nvim"; do
    echo "********************************************************************************"
    $vim --version
    for ft in "filetype on" "filetype off"; do
        for syn in "syntax on" "syntax off"; do
            echo "$vim $ft $syn"
            time $vim --clean -u <(echo -e "$ft\n$syn") "$largefile" +q
            echo "--------------------------------------------------"
        done
    done
    echo "********************************************************************************"
done
```


### Expected behavior

nvim 0.8.0 should open moderately a large file (1,000,000 lines, 66M) just as fast as vim and nvim 0.7.2 (about 0.15s) with `filetype on` or `syntax on`.

### Actual behavior

nvim 0.8.0 takes about 3 seconds to open a moderately large file (1,000,000 lines, 66M) when either of `filetype on` or `syntax on` is set.
**Of note**, opening a large file with what I presume to be a _known_ extension is not slow: Changing `largefile="$tmpdir/largefile"` in the script above to `largefile="$tmpdir/largefile.txt"` leads to nvim 0.8.0 opening the file quickly.
